부림절 직전의 샤밧(안식일)\n \n 유대인들은 매일 절기를 따라 정해진:
The Shabbat (Sabbath) right before Purim

 Jews read set portions of Scripture every day according to the calendar of feasts. On the Shabbat (Sabbath) right before Purim, they are to read Deuteronomy 25:17-19, and this passage begins with the words "Zachor et asher asa lecha Amalek (Remember what Amalek did unto thee)".
When Purim comes, every Jew must go to the synagogue and read the book of Esther.
Reading it together with other Jews is what matters.
